request: Analyze GSE87748 for PMID 28066330 (Muscle Contraction Induces Acute Hydroxymethylation of the Exercise-Responsive Gene Nr4a3.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

accessions: GSE87748 (RNA-seq SubSeries of SuperSeries GSE87749, S5.p1)
final.assay: total RNA-seq (Ribo-Zero), human vastus lateralis, HiSeq 2500 SR100
final.primary_estimand: within-subject change in skeletal-muscle gene expression 4 h after one 15-min bout of cycling at 80% VO2max vs resting basal biopsy, in 10 sedentary young men
final.inclusion: 10 male volunteers, biopsies at rest (basal) and 4 h post-exercise (S2.1.p1); all 20 samples deposited
planned_contrasts: post-exercise (240 min) vs basal (S3.1.p1; paper: 165 DEGs, 72 up / 93 down, of 6,242 genes tested)
final.normalization: featureCounts gene coverage; filter > 2.5 RPKM in >= 5 samples (S2.3.p1)
final.paper_method: edgeR glmQLFit/glmQLFTest (S2.3.p1; GEO data_processing edgeR v3.12.1); paired vs unpaired design not stated
final.paper_results: 165 DEGs (72 up, 93 down); NR4A3 top up (FC 26, FDR 2.51e-5); Table 1 top-10 up genes

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.1.p1 defines the paired pre/4h-post biopsy design; S2.3.p1 the edgeR QL method and RPKM filter; S3.1.p1 the 165-DEG result. The paper never states the DEG cutoff. The authors' deposited result table (6,242 genes) gives exactly 165 genes at FDR < 0.1 (72 up / 93 down, identical to S3.1.p1) and 141 at FDR < 0.05; Table 1 also lists METTL7B with FDR 0.080. So the paper's rule is FDR < 0.1 with no fold-change cutoff (inferred, not stated).

checks: S5.p1 names GSE87749 (SuperSeries); GEO series_id lists GSE87748,GSE87749
20 samples = 10 subjects x {Basal, 240 min}, matches S2.1.p1
stats file has 6,242 genes = '6,242 genes detected' (S3.1.p1)

ownership.reasoning: The paper cites the SuperSeries GSE87749; GSE87748 is its RNA-seq SubSeries with the human biopsies. Sample count, tested-gene count and processing all match the paper.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns equal metadata title exactly (20/20). Subject and time parsed from the title; they agree with characteristics individual/time. Subject recoded to strings so R treats it as a factor.

final.source: GSE87748_RNAseq_Readcoverage_v3.txt.gz restricted to the authors' 6,242 tested genes

matrix.reasoning: All values integer (0 to 5.7e6), file named Readcoverage, data_processing says featureCounts gene coverages: raw read counts, the input edgeR expects. The gene set is restricted to the authors' tested genes because the RPKM filter needs exon lengths that are not deposited (prep script).

design.subject: subject
design.reasoning: One exercise bout, two time points per subject (S2.1.p1). The estimand is the within-subject change Post vs Pre; subject is the repeated-measure unit. GEO treatment exercise/control is the same split as time, so it is not a separate factor.

candidates.reason_rejected: identical split to time; time is used

covariance.reasoning: Each subject contributes both arms, so subject is blocked as a fixed effect (standard edgeR paired design). The paper does not say whether it paired; an unpaired ~ time fit runs as sensitivity.

paper_route.method: edgeR glmQLFit/glmQLFTest after > 2.5 RPKM in >= 5 samples
paper_route.reason: RPKM filter replaced by the authors' deposited tested-gene list (no exon lengths deposited); pairing not stated in paper, paired design chosen

deviations: gene universe = authors' 6,242 tested genes instead of recomputed RPKM filter

method.reasoning: Raw counts support the paper's edgeR QL route; run it in R edgeR (tools.r_de_tools engine edger_ql, TMM) to match the paper's software. DESeq2 paired and edgeR unpaired are sensitivity runs.

final.deviation_note: FDR < 0.1 inferred from the deposited author table (exactly 165 = 72 up/93 down); paper text does not state the cutoff. FDR < 0.05 kept as audit rule.

threshold.reasoning: See paper_reconstruction: the deposited table reproduces S3.1.p1 exactly at FDR < 0.1, not 0.05.

caveats: threshold FDR < 0.1 is inferred from the authors' deposited table, not stated in text
pairing of the original edgeR model is not stated
gene universe taken from the authors' tested-gene list

study.reasoning: Paper's method and contrast reproduced with declared deviations in filter, software version and assumed pairing.

discrepancies.data: no exon lengths deposited; authors' 6,242-gene tested list deposited
